end.summary: Practised counting sides and corners of 2D shapes.
end.parentNote: Asha practised counting sides and corners and naming shapes in different positions. Ayaan described a four-sided shape with four corners and explained that a triangle still has three sides and corners when turned. They initially mixed up a tilted triangle with a four-sided shape, but corrected this later in the lesson. At home, show turned paper shapes and ask Ayaan to count the sides and corners.
